name: perf-gc-ab
description: T-018 / D-147 (the user's stutter: 150-250 ms freezes every ~10.5 s, like a garbage collection). 12 creatures around the player, 30 s per phase: GunPowdered with debug log on, with debug log off, then the whole mod off ([General] Enable Mod), then on again. Each phase reports frame times, the managed memory the whole game allocates per second and the GC count, so GunPowdered's share is the difference. Measures; it does not judge yet.
